CN Boot 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DeepSeek Harness 国内网络引导：探测 npm/npmmirror/GitHub/HuggingFace/Gitee 与本地代理，读取注册表配置，推荐镜像/代理并生成 PowerShell + bash 引导脚本。默认只读，apply 需显式开启。

posts.en:
CN Boot is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. China-network bootstrap for DeepSeek Harness: probes npm/npmmirror/GitHub/HuggingFace/Gitee and local proxies, reads registry config, recommends mirrors/proxy, generates a PowerShell + bash bootstrap. Read-only by default; apply is explicit.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4c97da2d4bf2501cc709.html
